You can support Baby Alex's family here: https://www.givesendgo.com/Baby-AlexShow more Join us for our VSRF Weekly Update
Featured guests with Founder, Steve Kirsch & Executive Director, Louisa Clary
Every Thursday 7 PM EST / 4 PM PST
Register at https://www.VacSafety.org
Thursday, December 15
7pm Eastern / 4pm Pacific
Our special guest will be Clifton Duncan – a star of the stage both on- and off- Broadway. He is an extraordinary talent and man. Clifton refused to comply with Broadway’s Covid vaccine mandate in 2021 and was willing to walk away from his career rather than risk his health. He currently hosts the Clifton Duncan Podcast on art, culture and society.
Joining us at the beginning of the show will be the parents of Baby Alex. After securing unvaccinated blood for a transfusion for Alex, the staff at Sacred Heart Children’s Hospital in Spokane, Washington couldn’t “locate” this donation and gave Alex vaccinated blood. He sadly developed a blood clot and died twelve days later.
The VSRF’s mission is to advance COVID-19 vaccine safety through scientific research, public education, and advocacy, and to support the vaccine injured. https://www.vacsafety.org/
We are grateful for your support which is vital to our work.
